description: The site replay of the core EULA-download changes requires `_sources/tpc-ds/EULA.txt` and `_sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt` beside downloadable query templates. The certified site bundle currently copies only document-linked files, so the site build fails when it tries to publish these companion licenses. Extend site-inputs download selection to include the matching TPC EULA when a TPC-DS or TPC-H query template is included. Keep the bundle limited to referenced downloads plus their required license sidecars; do not copy unrelated files. Preserve bundle attestations and generated paths.
